tableToken.description: O12 dine-in: the QR secret scanned at the table. The server stores tableId/tableCode, never the token.

message.description: Gift message to the recipient (≤ 300 chars)

variantUid.description: Optional variant id (size, gift-card denomination). Omit for the default variant. Not a variant of this product → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (lines.N.variantUid); a tạm hết variant → SELLABLE_UNAVAILABLE.

promotionCode.description: O8: customer-entered code; the server decides the discount

redeemPoints.description: O16: loyalty points to spend (signed-in customer, X-Customer-Token); quote answers loyalty.reason instead of failing

providerCode.description: The provider covering the remainder after the card

giftCardCode.description: O9: gift-card code applied as a co-payment. Debited at order create; never stored.
